fields.name: Send-Alert
fields.explanation: Enables sending alerts from this alert rule. Without it, alerts will not be sent.

fields.name: Appchi-$operator
fields.explanation: The team's personal notification policy connected to its contact point. The operator name is selected from Grafana notification policies that start with 'Appchi - '.

fields.name: application
fields.explanation: The application name. If omitted, the field will not appear in the alert.

fields.name: severity
fields.explanation: Alert severity. Defaults to 'high' if not provided.

fields.name: network
fields.explanation: Network identifier. Defaults to 'nesharim' if not provided.

fields.name: site
fields.explanation: The site this alert belongs to. Free-form text field, no predefined list of values.

fields.name: environment
fields.explanation: Deployment environment. Defaults to 'production' if not provided.

fields.name: message
fields.explanation: The alert message shown in notifications.

fields.name: impact
fields.explanation: Description of the business or operational impact.

fields.name: Runbook_url
fields.explanation: Link to the alert runbook or makhteg (מקט'ג).
